description:
Makes the game's own screens quicker to read and to act in. It adds no new windows and no notifications. The vanilla Line Manager, Statistics, entity windows and construction menu show more and need fewer clicks.

Line Manager: vehicle count and 12-month balance for each line, age for each vehicle. Reopening it selects the line you had selected. Cloning or replacing several vehicles asks first.
Line window: Add Vehicle and Remove Vehicle buttons in the Vehicles card, and a Stops card with the waiting passengers at each stop.
Statistics: quick filters and totals in the Lines, Vehicles and Stations tabs (for example Losing money, Problems, Old, Crowded, No lines). Columns sort by the value they show.
Windows: Statistics, Line Manager, Finances, Company and the notification log stay open side by side, also when you click the map. Sections you open stay open. Sell needs a second click.
Towns: the town window names what limits growth. Company: a locked perk says when a promotion is pending.
Construction: the Rail and Tracks menus share their tabs, and so do Road and Roads. The fastest track comes first. Configure opens a useful module tab. The bulldozer warns before it removes a station that lines use.
Game bar: the Earnings tooltip adds the last 30 days. Vehicle store: newest models first.

You can add it to a savegame and remove it again (it changes only the UI). If one of its changes fails, that screen falls back to vanilla. English and German.

Source code and issue tracker: https://github.com/maxblan/ui-overhaul
name: UI Overhaul
summary: The game's own screens show more and need fewer clicks: status in the Line Manager and Statistics, actions in the windows you already use, and windows that stay open.
